context.value_range: uniform draws in [0, 1), not a photograph

context.batch_norm_statistics: running_mean and running_var as written in weights.sacp
context.anchor_order: levels in order; inside a level, anchor h * width + w
context.self_check: the model's own inference output equals the one2many decode

context.batch_norm_statistics: batch statistics of the one training image
context.ground_truth_rows: batch.cls with batch.bboxes: class, then normalised xywh
context.loss_item_scaling: gain-scaled and multiplied by the batch size, which is 1
context.assigner_input_format: scores after sigmoid; boxes xyxy, pixels; both detached
context.target_box_format: xyxy, pixels; a row off the foreground holds ground truth 0
context.anchor_point_format: x, y of the cell centre, pixels
context.gradient_of: total_loss, with no optimizer step taken
context.statistics_after_forward: model.0.bn after the one train-mode pass

context.candidate_rule: before.running_var * (1 - momentum) + biased batch variance * momentum * batch_variance_scale, in float64, then float32
context.max_abs_difference: largest |candidate - after.running_var| over the channels, both read as float32
context.unit_case_state: weight, bias and running statistics drawn as batch_norm_perturbation of weights.sacp; input drawn standard normal
